_comment: The Colosseum CLI build this repository measures with. `revision` records where
the binary came from; `sha256` is what tools/setup_tools.ps1 and every wrapper
run actually enforce, because a revision cannot be read back out of a stripped
executable. `cli-v0.1.0` is not tagged yet, so this pins a local build of
D:/code/colosseum. PLAN B.2.6.3 re-pins to the published archive by filling in
`archive` and replacing `revision`, `sha256` and `version` here; nothing else
in the tree names a Colosseum build.
